author: reakz93
quote:
Visually: 8/10
Story and characters: 1/10
General GTA feeling and fun: 2/10
Wokeism and feminism: 11/10
Performance: 20-30 FPS
Gameplay: Very slow, exhausting, and heavily scripted. 

It feels like they took everything good and fun from previous GTA titles and completely stripped it away. 

The world looks nice on the surface, but the pacing is terrible, and there's very little actual freedom. On top of that, it runs at a choppy 20–30 FPS with noticeable stuttering, which makes the whole experience feel sluggish.

Save your money and skip this one - at least until it hits PC for under $15.
